title: Contents Packout & Storage Declared-Value Coverage in the Return Period
content:
For Contents Packout & Storage declared-value coverage on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job, **the fraction of the coverage period charged follows the scheduled return, the days being counted from the coverage period's first day through the scheduled return date with both of those days counted: when the job is in return scheduled status, its scheduled return date falls inside the coverage period being billed and those days number at least the coverage half-period days, the fraction is those days divided by the tier's period length; when the job is in return scheduled status, its scheduled return date falls inside the coverage period being billed and those days number fewer than the coverage half-period days, the fraction is the coverage half-period days divided by the tier's period length; in every other case, including a job with no scheduled return date, the fraction is one.**

The coverage period being billed is the storage period, counted in whole periods of the tier's period length from the custody start date, that contains the day the line is charged. The coverage half-period figure is 15 days.

For a declared-value coverage line priced in this way, and only for such a line, the period in which the scheduled return falls is charged for the fraction stated here; a vault storage line priced under the customer vault storage rule remains under that rule, and every other storage line still stops accruing with the storage period in which the contents are returned, billed in full, and no period starting after the returned date is billed.

## Input – judgement – fraction (30-day period length)

| Return scheduled status? | Return date inside the coverage period being billed? | Days counted both ends | Fraction |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 15 or more | those days divided by 30 |
| yes | yes | fewer than 15 | 15 divided by 30 |
| yes | no | — | one |
| no | — | — | one |

**Cases (hypothetical period running from the 12th of a month).** Return on the 3rd of the following month in a 31-day month: the 12th through the 3rd is 23 days, fraction 23 divided by 30. Return on the 14th: 3 days, fraction 15 divided by 30.
